title: Smoky Stew with Gem Lettuce Salad
description: Hearty smoky stew paired with a refreshing gem lettuce salad, a classic German comfort food.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped bacon and cook until crispy.
Add cubed potatoes, chopped onions, and a pinch of salt.
Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the gem lettuce salad by mixing torn lettuce, chopped bacon, and a drizzle of German mustard.
Serve the smoky stew hot, accompanied by the refreshing gem lettuce salad.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and a sprinkle of paprika.
